customer: Hello, I'm a college student in Virginia and I'm thinking about selling my full-size SUV since I barely drive it on campus. Could I just drive it over to one of your stores and get a quote on the spot? Thank you for your help!
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Our stores no longer give walk-in quotes, so the first step is getting an instant offer online using your SUV's VIN or license plate. After that, you can book an appraisal appointment at a store or, in most states, at your home through our Home pickup service, where a specialist inspects the car in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer. You'll find the full process in our article "Selling your car to Northwind: how it works," and please remember to bring everything on the appointment checklist.
